items.title: File Akron business net profit tax return
items.authority: City of Akron Income Tax Division
items.description: Businesses with income in Akron file the municipal net profit tax return (2.5% rate).

items.title: File Cincinnati business income tax return
items.authority: City of Cincinnati Income Tax Division
items.description: Businesses engaged in Cincinnati (rental property, sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations) file the business net profit return at the city's 1.8% rate.

items.title: Withhold and remit Cincinnati income tax
items.authority: City of Cincinnati Income Tax Division
items.description: Employers register for and remit withholding for employees working in Cincinnati.

items.title: File Cleveland municipal net profit return (CCA)
items.description: C and S corporations, partnerships and LLCs doing business in Cleveland file the net profit return with the Central Collection Agency; due 105 days after fiscal year end.

items.title: Withhold and remit Cleveland municipal income tax (CCA)
items.description: Employers withhold and remit municipal income tax through the Central Collection Agency using the employer EIN.

items.title: File Columbus municipal net profit tax return
items.authority: City of Columbus Income Tax Division (City Auditor)
items.description: Businesses (sole proprietorships, partnerships, corporations) with activity in Columbus file the city's annual business net profit return; some businesses may elect to file through the Ohio Department of Taxation.

items.title: Withhold and remit Columbus municipal income tax
items.authority: City of Columbus Income Tax Division (City Auditor)
items.description: Employers withhold municipal income tax on wages for work performed in Columbus.

note: No Dayton-specific business return due date was found in the search results.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Dayton
items.description: Review the cited local licensing source before operating; requirements may be activity-specific and can differ by business type or location.

items.title: File Toledo municipal net profit tax return
items.authority: City of Toledo Division of Taxation
items.description: Businesses with income in Toledo file the net profit tax return (2.5% rate); partnerships and corporations must have 90% of the tax paid by December 15. A federal extension does not extend the time to pay.
